reconfigure.description: Sign in again for {location}, for example after changing your password or when Autobayt gives you a new server address. It must be the same Autobayt account.

data_description.email: The email you sign in to the Autobayt app with.
data_description.password: Your Autobayt app password. It is used once to get a sign-in token and is not stored.

data_description.host: Only change this if Autobayt gave you a different server address.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Autobayt server.

abort.no_locations: This Autobayt account has no locations.
abort.wrong_account: That is a different Autobayt account than the one this home was added with.
abort.location_missing: This Autobayt account no longer has this home.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to ask Autobayt for switch states, in seconds, while push updates are off or unavailable.
data_description.shutter_models: Comma-separated model names to treat as shutters, if a shutter shows up as switches.
data_description.push: Autobayt sends changes to Home Assistant as they happen. Needs a public HTTPS address for Home Assistant (port 443); without one, or when off, states are read at the interval above.
data_description.energy: Show power and today's energy for power-metering (PM) devices.
data_description.energy_timezone: IANA time zone that decides when the day starts, for example Asia/Amman. Defaults to the time zone of Home Assistant.
data_description.light_words: A channel whose name contains one of these comma-separated words is shown as a light; the rest are switches. The light channel on a shutter plate is always a light.
data_description.swap_shutter_direction: Turn on if Open moves your shutters down. By default button 1 on the plate drives the motor up and button 2 drives it down.
data_description.shutter_travel_time: Seconds a shutter takes from fully closed to fully open. Leave empty if unsure. When set, shutters can be moved to a position and are stopped once they reach the end.

error.invalid_timezone: Not a known time zone. Use a name such as Europe/Berlin or Asia/Amman.

auth_failed.message: Autobayt no longer accepts the saved sign-in. Sign in again.

no_travel_time.message: Set the shutter travel time in the Autobayt options to move a shutter to a position.

push_public_url.title: Autobayt push updates need a public HTTPS address
push_public_url.description:
Push updates are unavailable for: {homes}.

Set a public HTTPS address on port 443 under Settings → System → Network → Home Assistant URL, or configure Home Assistant Cloud. Internal addresses, IP addresses and plain HTTP URLs cannot be used.

Devices continue updating through polling. Registration will retry after 15 minutes on a successful device poll. Reload the integration to try sooner.

push_subscription_failed.title: Autobayt push registration failed
push_subscription_failed.description:
Push updates are unavailable for: {homes}.

Reason: {reason}.

For HTTP 401 or 403, check the account sign-in and ask Autobayt support to verify webhook permissions. For HTTP 404, verify the server address and ask support whether it supports webhooks. For rate limits, server errors or connection failures, check connectivity and allow time for the service to recover. For other rejected requests or unexpected responses, contact Autobayt support with the reason above.

Devices continue updating through polling. Registration will retry after 15 minutes on a successful device poll. Reload the integration to try sooner.

push_incomplete_response.title: Autobayt returned incomplete push registration details
push_incomplete_response.description:
Push updates are unavailable for: {homes}.

The server response is missing a subscription ID, generation or signing secret. Contact Autobayt support to check the webhook registration response.

Devices continue updating through polling. Registration will retry after 15 minutes on a successful device poll. Reload the integration to try sooner.

push_replaced.title: Another Home Assistant took over Autobayt push updates
push_replaced.description:
Push updates are unavailable for: {homes}.

Autobayt supports one push subscription per account. Another Home Assistant replaced this subscription. Turn off push updates on the other instance, then reload this integration. Automatic registration retries are stopped to prevent the instances from repeatedly replacing each other.

Devices continue updating through polling.

push_no_devices.title: Autobayt push updates have no devices to subscribe to
push_no_devices.description:
No devices were discovered for: {homes}.

Check that these homes have devices in the Autobayt app and that this account can access them. If devices appear in the app but not here, contact Autobayt support to check their location assignments and device API response.

Home Assistant continues polling and will try registration when devices are discovered.
